content.text: Hydrocortisone 100 mg IV over 30 s, repeated q6–8h for the first 24 h; then usually 150 mg over the second 24 h and 75 mg on the third day if markedly improved, then oral maintenance (hydrocortisone 15–20 mg + fludrocortisone 0.1 mg daily). Any delay in glucocorticoid, including for testing, may be fatal.
